crossRefs.note: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,
and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.

translations.web: You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which Yahweh chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you.
translations.bsb: You must abide by the verdict they give you at the place the LORD will choose. Be careful to do everything they instruct you,
translations.kjv: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform
translations.asv: And thou shalt do according to the tenor of the sentence which they shall show thee from that place which Jehovah shall choose; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they shall teach thee:
